observations: Torah #114 is a narrative account (not a structured teaching) in which Reb Noson describes Rebbe Nachman revealing the severity of the damage of improper thoughts (pegam ha-hirhur). The text is entirely first-person testimony about a revelation, containing no bechina language and no conceptual-equivalence statements. The single core concept — pegam ha-hirhur (damage of improper thought) — is presented causally (thoughts cause damage). There are no bechina-connected concepts, let alone the 3+ required for a new package.
